summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by LuxExperience B.V. (formerly MYT Netherlands Parent B.V.) furnishing its quarterly interim report for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026, along with an earnings press release. The filing contains standard financial results, operating metrics, and segment disclosures related to the prior YNAP acquisition and the classification of THE OUTNET as a discontinued operation. There is no announcement of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. The filing is a regular periodic report with no event-driven catalyst.
